strategy.summary: PR #3390 fixes two CVXOPT conic-presolve defects in compress_matrix: (1) it treated a negative-multiple inequality row as redundant, merging opposite half-spaces (z<=1 vs z>=1 stored as -z<=-1), enlarging the feasible set so the LP was reported UNBOUNDED/-inf instead of optimal 1.0; (2) it recovered duals of merged duplicate inequalities via P_leq @ z, double counting each merged row and violating KKT stationarity. Reproduce by solving the two small LPs with solver='CVXOPT' on the buggy commit and observing unbounded/-inf and duals that do not sum to 1.0.

input_output_examples.input: Minimize z s.t. x+y==1, 2*x+2*y==2, z<=1, z>=1, x>=0, y>=0; prob.solve(solver='CVXOPT')
input_output_examples.buggy_output: prob.status == unbounded (INFEASIBLE_OR_UNBOUNDED) and/or prob.value == -inf, because z>=1 (stored as -z<=-1) was merged into z<=1, leaving no lower bound
input_output_examples.expected_output: prob.status == cp.OPTIMAL and prob.value == 1.0 (assertAlmostEqual)

input_output_examples.input: Minimize z s.t. x+y==1, 2*x+2*y==2, c1: z>=1, c2: z>=1, x>=0, y>=0; prob.solve(solver='CVXOPT')
input_output_examples.buggy_output: Dual of the merged row copied to every duplicate (double counting): prob.value == 1.0 but c1.dual_value + c2.dual_value == 2.0 (i.e. != 1.0), violating stationarity in z
input_output_examples.expected_output: prob.value == 1.0 and c1.dual_value + c2.dual_value == 1.0 (assertAlmostEqual)

input_output_examples.input: Maximize z s.t. x+y==1, 2*x+2*y==2, c1: z<=1, c2: 2*z<=2, x>=0, y>=0; prob.solve(solver='CVXOPT') (scaled duplicate, ratio 2)
input_output_examples.buggy_output: prob.value == 1.0 but the dual of the kept row is copied to the scaled duplicate, so stationarity in z fails (dual sum not equal to 1)
input_output_examples.expected_output: prob.value == 1.0 and stationarity in z holds (dual expansion assigns each compressed dual to the row kept and zero to dropped duplicates)

input_output_examples.input: compress_matrix(sp.csr_matrix([[1.0,0.0],[-1.0,0.0]]), np.array([1.0,-1.0]))  # x<=1 and -x<=-1 are opposite half-spaces

input_output_examples.expected_output: compress_matrix returns (A_compr, b_compr, P, rows_kept); rows_kept == [0, 3, 4] for the 6-row example, and for x<=1 / -x<=-1 both rows are kept (A_compr == A, b_compr == b)
